# Recommendation

**Proceed with the migration immediately.** All system metrics are healthy (CPU 38%, memory 51%, disk I/O 12%, cache hit ratio 0.91, GC pause 18ms, latency 142ms baseline), infrastructure is stable (backup complete, TLS renewed, all pods healthy), and the read-only replica mode is already active—this is the optimal window to execute the migration without performance risk or data consistency concerns.
